currentPhase.description: RC715 remains the promoted standalone forensic baseline. RC718 is the active automation-ready development candidate and awaits the focused RC719 human naming and persistence gate.

developmentBaseline.candidate: RC718 editable imported plan naming candidate

promotedBaseline.candidate: RC715 durable library and rename candidate

authorizedWork: standalone functional, UX, accessibility, persistence, performance, test, and release improvements through bounded pull requests
permanent player CI and black-box behavioral protection
preparation of one bounded and reversible architectural seam
heldWork: localStorage to IndexedDB migration until a dedicated migration gate is accepted
prohibitedWork: maintaining a separate canonical standalone source outside GitHub
mixing a functional correction with a transversal architecture, storage, identifier, or contract migration
microservices before a demonstrated extraction need
synchronization of opaque global snapshots as the sole merge model
canonical identifiers derived from editable titles
direct UI coupling to storage or remote APIs
parallel AI implementation without exact baseline and machine-checkable scopes
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
presenting target architecture as current implementation

activeRisks.statement: Branch protection and mandatory review rules are not yet independently verified through repository policy evidence.
Changed-file scope enforcement for AI work packages is specified but not yet implemented.
The imported baseline has strong reconstruction and test evidence, but the repository does not yet run the complete permanent player browser matrix on every sensitive pull request.
activeRisks.closureGate: permanent player CI and browser gate accepted

activeRisks.statement: The human promotion is recorded as accountable-owner attestation without raw device recordings or per-case human test logs in the repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or acceptance of owner attestation as the durable record

activeRisks.statement: RC718 plan-name editing passed bounded automated checks but has not yet completed the focused Android and desktop close/reopen human gate.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Permanent player CI and representative black-box regression fixtures protect the promoted RC715 behavior before the first architectural seam is implemented. RC719 human validation is additionally required before RC718 can replace the promoted standalone baseline.

review.lastReviewedBy: Architecture & Repository Governor — RC718 development candidate review
review.nextReviewTrigger: RC719 human naming/persistence result, first architectural seam proposal, serious regression, release provenance change, or phase-gate request
